title: Bug: Remove Frame is a no-op (regression, nothing happens on keyboard Delete or context menu)
description: After recent layout changes (task 0712 moved Timeline to a top dock), Remove Frame does nothing — neither keyboard Delete/Backspace nor the context menu 'Remove Frame/Frames' action removes any frames. Likely regression: the onRemoveFrames prop from Shell.tsx is not being passed through to the new top-docked Timeline, OR the Timeline is no longer receiving keyboard focus so Delete key events don't fire. Check: (1) is onRemoveFrames wired from Shell.tsx to the Timeline in the new dock? (2) does the Timeline container have tabIndex=-1 and onKeyDown? (3) did the 0712 layout refactor break the prop wiring?
